provenance: Arose from inspecting the chronological holdout during the Stage 2 audit. It must never be reported as a historical-holdout improvement.
hypothesis: Source role carries discrimination; position/transition priors carry the correct absolute level. Shrinkage as implemented conflates the two and degrades the ranking it is meant to protect.
architecture: position (and possibly transition-type) prior supplies a calibrated baseline level
source feature/start rate supplies RELATIVE ordering around that baseline
source appearances govern how far a player may move from the baseline, not the baseline itself
fittingRule: Any coefficients must be fitted on the TRAINING cohort alone. If it cannot be specified without further holdout inspection it stays unfitted and remains a registered hypothesis.
decision: LEFT UNFITTED this milestone. The holdout has been inspected repeatedly and cannot serve as a training set; O6 is reserved for prospective testing from GW3.
